svg.aria-label: Four panels on the toy: byte conversion removes the gradient, identical sentence vectors give zero difference, a pixel with all colours clamped gets zero gradient, and a soft clamp passes a small slope where a hard clamp passes none.
svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Four ways the push can get no signal
.byte() on the colours
both sentences get the same vector
all three colours clamped
a hard clamp against a soft clamp
truncates
The value drops its decimals and leaves the graph.
has a gradient: no
The push path uses a copy of the map without it.
score difference 0, largest gradient 0
A text encoder that cannot tell two word orders apart
gives this push nothing to follow.
pixel B set to (3, −3, 0, −3)
colours before the clamp: 720, 485, 385
pixel B's gradient row: 0 on all four channels
Every channel of this pixel is cut off.
pixel B red at 305, gradient on its z₀:
The soft clamp keeps slope 0.0759 at that value (sharpness 0.05).
It lets some signal through and changes every other value too.
Step W3 records this choice before any picture is pushed.
Toy with hand-set weights: it shows the mechanics and predicts nothing about SDXL.
